summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py, exported it from monai/losses/__init__.py, documented it in docs/source/losses.rst, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py. Nothing was run or committed, so the code and tests are unverified. The formula is reconstructed from memory of Fidon et al. (2017) and should be checked against the paper. With a distance matrix of 1 - I, the loss should equal GeneralizedDiceLoss with square weighting; the test checks this but has not been run.
